accepted_active_ceilings_mib.basis: Selected child-path Wave 0 projections plus frozen headroom; replaced by integrated Wave 5 evidence.

conditions: Wave 1 first subgate must produce matched ordinary-server versus SDK/protocol-linked default-path evidence before schema/runtime work proceeds.
Wave 5 must replace projections with integrated selected-path evidence and may revise ceilings only through documented evidence and review.
architecture_review.note: Manual gate metadata added after independent architecture review; the measurement harness intentionally cannot self-accept.

decision.decision_rule: Ordinary no-plugin server must stay within 24/32 MiB and not construct an Engine or spawn a host. Guest trap/CPU/memory survival and child in-flight crash/recovery/cleanup are mandatory blockers for both Rust and TypeScript. Real TypeScript component evidence and actual import inspection are required. Child variants are measured under the SDK-only parent probe. Fair selection uses warm/peak/cold material thresholds; fault containment picks child only when neither placement materially regresses. Projected product totals are temporary probe cross-checks only.

hostile_probe_safety_caps_mib.note: StoreLimits linear-memory safety caps for grow_memory hostile probes only. Not product active-RSS budgets and not frozen Wave 1 acceptance ceilings.

reasons: child rust shutdown cleaned with no orphan
child rust in-flight crash/recovery survived with parent healthy
child typescript shutdown cleaned with no orphan
child typescript in-flight crash/recovery survived with parent healthy
fair comparator thresholds: warm>max(15%,8.0MiB), peak>max(20%,32.0MiB), cold>max(25%,100.0ms)
no material warm/peak/cold regression on Rust+TS; fault containment selects on-demand child host

post.ancestor_exclusion_method: bounded cycle-safe /proc/<pid>/stat ppid walk from harness pid; exclude harness + ancestors only; malformed/missing ppid stops walk
post.confounder_match_method: direct build/browser exe identity; node/nodejs only with recognized build/preview/test tool markers in comm/cmdline; bare pi/node is not a hit; active CPU tick delta still required
post.method: post: historical load averages informational only (include campaign CPU); still enforce active external confounder CPU tick deltas and swap I/O rate threshold

swap_io.method: combined pswpin+pswpout page rate over sample window; >= 256 pages/s (>= 1 MiB/s at 4096-byte pages) enforced; below-threshold activity informational only

pre.ancestor_exclusion_method: bounded cycle-safe /proc/<pid>/stat ppid walk from harness pid; exclude harness + ancestors only; malformed/missing ppid stops walk
pre.confounder_match_method: direct build/browser exe identity; node/nodejs only with recognized build/preview/test tool markers in comm/cmdline; bare pi/node is not a hit; active CPU tick delta still required
pre.method: pre: enforce CPU-scaled historical load thresholds; active confounder CPU tick deltas; swap I/O rate threshold

swap_io.method: combined pswpin+pswpout page rate over sample window; >= 256 pages/s (>= 1 MiB/s at 4096-byte pages) enforced; below-threshold activity informational only

measured_preliminary_active_ceilings_mib.basis: projected_product = server_baseline + max(0, variant - sdk_only); selected-profile ceilings use selected placement only + headroom
measured_preliminary_active_ceilings_mib.headroom_rule: ceil = max(projected_max * 1.25, projected_max + 8 MiB) for Rust; max(projected_max * 1.25, projected_max + 16 MiB) for TypeScript; unresolved when required series are missing
limitations: Projection is not an integrated server+host measurement.
Projection is not SDK-linked integrated junban-server proof; Wave 1 must measure matched server-with-SDK default path.
Wave 5 must measure actual product server+host and may revise ceilings.
Raw probe/child cgroup totals alone must not be frozen as product budgets.
measured_preliminary_active_ceilings_mib.note: Preliminary Wave 0 ADR numbers only. Not authoritative Wave 1 acceptance gates until five-sample idle-host evidence is recorded and accepted.

rust_wasm32_wasip2_baseline.ctx: empty env/args; stdin closed; stdout/stderr sink; no preopens/sockets/http
rust_wasm32_wasip2_baseline.linker_note: Spike may call p2::add_to_linker_async which defines a broader interface set than these five imports. That is NOT the product selective linker; Wave 2 must import-lint exact baseline+grants.

typescript_pure.note: zero WASI imports; host must not broaden linker for TS
